name: Naomi
source: A rookie ParaMail rider who has been assigned to the First Unit. She is Miranda's childhood friend. Due to her debts, she runs around day and night in Arzenal to pay them off. In order to survive, she trusts her companions and believes that teamwork can help people survive for longer. Due to this, Naomi is known as the peacemaker within her team.
